tasks.name: Character Specification
tasks.objective: Produce the Character Specification for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every character class has a silhouette, palette and material plan
Customisation dimensions and their allowed values listed
Polygon, texture and bone budgets stated per class

tasks.name: Character Pack
tasks.objective: Produce the Character Pack for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every character rigs and deforms correctly at the stated bone count
Skinning weights verified on extreme poses
Modular pieces share a material set and attach without gaps

tasks.name: Character Review
tasks.objective: Produce the Character Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: No visible seams, clipping or untextured areas in the build
All customisation combinations render without missing assets
